title: Image of one stabilizer component is its label orbit
statement: In the geometric setting of the parent representative-component-cover node, take a single label x and its exact stabilizer K. Put F=C^K as the intersection of equalizers, U=D(h in F), q:D(h)→U. Suppose an open immersion f:U→Y×Spec H is over H and q followed by f and projection to Y is fixedSplitSection x. For every label y and point a of D(h), the explicit split section over H s_y(a) belongs to opensRange f if and only if ∃ζ∈G, A(ζ)(x)=y. This is a single-component statement, with no family of representatives, no completeness, and no distinctness hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 03SF, finite Galois covers and permutation sets; stabilizer quotient image argument

proof.text: Put V=D(h), v:V→Spec H. For any point z of V×_H V use Spec κ(z) and its two projection morphisms. Compose with V→Spec C and use full faithfulness of Spec to obtain ring maps α,β:C→κ(z). The pullback condition makes their restrictions to H equal, and α(h) is nonzero because the morphism factors through D(h). Apply hrot to obtain ζ with α∘ρ(ζ)=β. Cancel the open immersion V→Spec C and use pullback hom_ext: the residue-field morphism of z factors through the graph (deck ζ,id). Evaluation at the unique point of Spec κ(z) shows that the deck graphs jointly cover all points of V×_H V. No finite étale isomorphism or algebraic closure is needed.

C is finite over H, hence finite over every intermediate H-subalgebra F by Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite H F C. In particular C is integral over F=C^K. The inclusion F→C is injective; RingHom.IsIntegral.comap_surjective gives lying over. A prime above a point of D(h in F) avoids h, so restriction q:V→D(h in F) is surjective. The given projection equations, restriction compatibility and pullback hom_ext give q≫f=s_x over H, where s_x is fixedSplitSectionOver. Surjectivity therefore gives range(f)=range(s_x). This works for every intermediate subalgebra, without using the stabilizer condition.

The private connected-summand reconstruction argument proves deck(ζ)≫fixedSplitSection(x)=fixedSplitSection(A(ζ)x), with the concrete label defining fixedPunctureDescentAction. Each coproduct injection has clopen range; the connected nonempty puncture maps into its generic-point summand, and projection to T identifies the resulting factor with k. Set Z=Y×Spec H, Q=Z×_H V, l_y=(s_y,id):V→Q, and r:V×_H V→Q the base change of s_x. Mathlib Scheme.Pullback.range_map gives range(r)=fst⁻¹(range(s_x)). Projection calculations identify every deck graph followed by r with l_(A(ζ)x). Map Q to Y×_R T using its projections and k, then apply δ; l_y becomes k followed by the y-th coproduct injection. The sigmaι_eq_iff lemma therefore makes ranges of different l_y disjoint. If s_y(a) lies in range(f), l_y(a) lies in range(r); choose a preimage, cover it by a deck graph, and use disjointness to get y=A(ζ)x. Conversely this equality places l_y(a) in range(r), hence s_y(a) in range(f)=opensRange(f). All reasoning takes place on ordinary scheme points. For d=0 no x exists, and for the trivial group the only orbit label is x.

Replaced the geometric-fibre isomorphism argument by residue-field deck-graph point coverage, and orbit-polynomial integrality by finiteness over an intermediate subalgebra. No new postponed statements.

mathlib_searches.query: Every point of a scheme split by a faithfully flat cover lies on the image of one of the split sections
image of the quotient by a stabilizer in a finite etale cover is exactly the union of labelled sections in its orbit
mathlib_searches.results: PreGaloisCategory.fiberIsoQuotientStabilizer; FintypeCat.isoQuotientStabilizerOfIsConnected; IsFractionRing.stabilizerHom_surjective. None identifies the explicit scheme morphisms in this statement.

No duplicate explicit section over H or orbit image statement in Sheaf or WeilConjectures. Mathlib flat_and_surjective_SpecMap_iff, Pullback.range_fst, IsOpenImmersion.lift, sigmaOpenCover supply point lifting. RingTheory.Invariant.Basic supplies integrality but not the scheme-image criterion.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Used Mathlib ingredients for the proved point-lifting statement; no exact image criterion.
